tasks.gr10-paper1-revision-t4: Topic: Revision of Paper 1, Language in context, for Grade 10 English HL, with marks shown in the questions. Cover the sections and marks (comprehension 30, summary 10, language structures and conventions 30, total 70 in two hours), command words (state, identify, quote, in your own words, explain, why), inference and word-in-context questions on short original passages, fact versus opinion, summary writing (main points, no examples, own words), direct and indirect speech, active and passive voice, concord, persuasive techniques in adverts, and time per mark. Ask exam-style questions with the marks stated.
tasks.gr10-paper2-literature-revision-t4: Topic: Revision of Paper 2, Literature, for Grade 10 English HL, with marks shown in the questions. Cover the structure (poetry 30 marks: seen 20 from two of four poems, unseen 10; novel or drama 50 marks: essay 25 and contextual question 25 from the same section), metaphor, simile, tone and theme in a short original poem, stage directions and characterisation in a short original drama extract, a four-step plan for unseen poems, the literary essay (300 to 350 words, content 60%, language and structure 40%) and a thesis. Ask exam-style questions with the marks stated.
tasks.gr10-paper3-paper4-revision-t4: Topic: Revision of Paper 3, Writing, and Paper 4, Oral, for Grade 10 English HL, with marks shown in the questions. Cover the marks (Paper 3 100: essay 50 and two transactional texts of 25 each; Paper 4 oral 50), choosing narrative, descriptive or argumentative essays from the topic wording, planning, a two-hour time plan, the signals of each transactional text (letters, CV, agenda and minutes, report, review, articles, speech, dialogue, interview), word limits (300 to 350 and 180 to 200), and the oral tasks (listening 15, prepared speech 10, unprepared speech 15; vote of thanks; panel discussion conventions). Ask exam-style questions with the marks stated.
